_comment: Skills improve through use up to a cap of min(max, per_level * level + 5). 'defaults' applies to every class unless classes.json overrides it.

skills.name: Dodge
skills.description: Chance to step aside from a melee attack.

skills.name: Parry
skills.description: Chance to turn aside a melee attack with your weapon.

skills.name: Riposte
skills.description: Chance to block a melee attack and strike back at once.

skills.name: Double Attack
skills.description: Chance to swing twice in one round.

skills.name: Channeling
skills.description: Keeps a spell going when you are hit while casting.

skills.name: Dual Wield
skills.description: Chance to swing your off-hand weapon (or second fist) each round.

skills.name: Enhanced Damage
skills.description: Makes your melee blows land harder.

skills.name: Sneak
skills.description: Moving quietly, unnoticed by more creatures.

skills.name: Tracking
skills.description: How far away you can sense creatures.

skills.name: Feign Death
skills.description: Convincing your foes that you are dead.
